DolibarrCrmConnectorEnabledDesc.message: Enables shared notes on emails, the "Link" tab (search/link quotations, orders, invoices...) and automatic reference detection in emails. Requires the CRM Client Connector module installed and enabled on your Dolibarr.

CrmConnectorFeatureDisabled.message: Feature disabled : enable the CRM Client Connector connection in the extension settings

NoThirdpartyNoDocuments.message: No thirdparty identified : no document can be displayed

dolibarrQuotationTrustedSendersDesc.message: If an email comes from one of these senders (exact address or domain, e.g. : @myshop.com) and contains the X-Quotation-Mail / X-Quotation-Data headers (Prestashop tsquotationform module), the thirdparty will be searched/created from these headers instead of the mail sender.

NoDolibarrContentDetected.message: No Dolibarr content detected for this email

NoDolibarrContentDetectedDetails.message: This banner is always shown by the Dolibarr Connector extension, whether or not Dolibarr content (quotation, order, note...) was found for this email : it is a protection against phishing. If you see this message together with another block imitating the usual look of the last message or the linked document, this is very likely a fraudulent email.

UseMasterPassword.message: Use a master password to protect the API key

UseMasterPasswordDesc.message: Recommended: Your API key will be encrypted and require a password at each startup

DolibarrAccountMappingDesc.message: A mailbox always uses a single Dolibarr connection at a time. Mailboxes not mapped here use the default connection.

DolibarrPermissionNotice.message: When you save a Dolibarr connection, this add-on automatically requests permission to access its address (a permission scoped to that one site). If that isn't enough and one or more connections stay blocked, you can, as a last resort, widen the add-on's access to all websites using the button below - this unblocks every configured Dolibarr connection at once. This broader permission should otherwise be avoided, to keep the add-on's access to the strict minimum.

DolibarrPermissionNoticeFallback.message: If the button above fails, you can also enable this permission manually:

DolibarrRequestPermissionDenied.message: Permission denied - you can try again or follow the manual steps below

DolibarrPermissionStep1.message: Open the "Tools" menu > "Add-ons and Themes" (or the puzzle-piece icon in the toolbar).

DolibarrPermissionStep2.message: Click on "Dolibarr connector" in the add-ons list.

DolibarrPermissionStep4.message: Turn on the "Access your data for all websites" toggle.
